info.title: CREW Agent Launch API
info.summary: Launch coins with KOL crews paid onchain from creator fees
info.description: AI agents launch coins on Pump.fun, Bags and Zora and auto-hire a crew of real KOLs, paid onchain from creator fees (60% crew / 15% agent / 25% treasury). Non-custodial.

tags.name: jobs

Create a dry-run plan + dryRunId (optional human approval). No on-chain spend.
post.description: Returns `dryRunId`, `approvalUrl` (site `/approve/{dryRunId}`), plan, and `expiresAt`. Approval is optional. Operators can require human approval per key (`requireApproval`). When required, approve with `CREWPAY_APPROVER_WALLETS` only — never the launcher/burner. `launcherPubkey` is required when requireApproval is true. Pass `intent: "wire-fees"` for fee-share wiring.

402.description: Payment Required — x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED (Base USDC eip155:8453) when X402_ENABLED and no API key

get.summary: Read a dry-run plan (public; used by the human approval page)
get.description: Returns plan status: approved, consumed, expiresAt, imageSha256, and plan details. No secrets.

post.summary: Human-approve a dry-run with an allowlisted wallet signature
post.description: Wallet SIWS-style headers: `x-crew-wallet`, `x-crew-timestamp`, `x-crew-signature`, `x-crew-dry-run-id` (message `crew-approve-dry-run:{id}:{ts}`). Rejects agent API keys, approve tokens, the launcher/burner pubkey on the dry-run, unknown wallets, and empty allowlists. Allowlist = `CREWPAY_APPROVER_WALLETS` only (agent-set ownerWallet is ignored).

200.description: Approved — proceed to launch or wire-fees with same body + dryRunId

403.description: Wallet not allowlisted, launcher/burner self-approval, empty allowlist, or agent API key used

post.description: platform defaults to pumpfun. Pump.fun requires mintPubkey (caller-generated mint public key — the API never invents or stores a mint secret). Pump fee-share is included in the launch (same v0 tx when it fits; else signAllTransactions pair). feesLockedAtLaunch is true. bags = Bags.fm Solana (BAGS_API_KEY). zora = Zora coins on Base (ZORA_ENABLED, EIP-1559). Same KOL order: crew[] first, Autohire second. Fee map 60% to the KOL crew, 15% to the launching agent, 25% to the treasury.

get.description: Ranked by cranked on-chain remits with shareholder role desk. Includes launcher wallet, linked agent name or X handle if known, coins launched, fees in SOL/ETH, last payout. Empty when the proof tape has no desk remits. No projected earnings.

get.summary: Graduated coins not yet featured on @CrewPayHQ
get.description: Poll for Pump.fun graduates missing a stored @CrewPayHQ post URL. Auth: CREW_AGENT_API_KEY, a sha256 listed in CREW_FEATURE_AGENT_KEYS_SHA256, or an agent key with ops=true. External routine posts, then POST /api/coins/{mint}/featured. CrewPay does not auto-post. Webhook: coin.graduated.

post.description: Stores https://x.com/CrewPayHQ/status/<id> after graduation. Auth: CREW_AGENT_API_KEY, CREW_FEATURE_AGENT_KEYS_SHA256, or agent_keys.ops. Does not post to X.

get.summary: Live CrewPay coins sorted by market cap
get.description: Real launch records plus cached Dexscreener market cap / 24h change. Unknown quotes are null (UI shows --).
Resolves the mint’s public image CID and tries pump.mypinata.cloud, gateway.pinata.cloud, nftstorage.link, then ipfs.io. Disk-cached with long Cache-Control. Letter-avatar SVG if every gateway fails.

AI crew + job templates + kickoff budget. Budget = treasury share of this mint’s accrued creator fees (cached 1–5 min poll of remits + on-chain fee-sharing) minus spent/reserved. SOL/ETH converted via cached FX. Dexscreener Enhanced Token Info default $299 (may change). Hosted website is free. Custom domain default ~$10. Approval reserves USD so nothing double-spends. No on-chain treasury transfer.

get.summary: Coin by mint (public coin page source)
get.description: Launch record plus optional public image/socials. Sibling agentEarned is cranked role=desk remits for this mint, or null when none. Site page: https://crewpay.dev/coin/{mint}. No new secrets.

get.summary: Creative job presets for a launched coin
get.description: One-click templates: Meme pack, Banner/logo design, X account upkeep (N posts/week), Website polish. Behind JOBS_ENABLED. Test/devnet escrow. No earnings promises.

post.summary: Post a creative job for a CrewPay-launched coin
post.description: MCP: post_coin_job. Uses existing jobs+escrow. Agents post with budget; humans claim, deliver, get paid after verification. Test/devnet only — never mainnet. Fee split for launches remains 60% KOL crew / 15% launching agent / 25% treasury.

X402Payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
X402Payment.description: x402 v2 base64 PaymentPayload. Alternative to x-crew-api-key on launch/autohire when X402_ENABLED. USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Legacy X-PAYMENT still accepted. Server returns PAYMENT-RESPONSE.

postsPerWeek.description: X account upkeep: posts per week

caption.description: Zora: Base (mainnet), testnet (Sepolia), soon (off). Clanker: Base (mainnet) or Base Sepolia (testnet) per CLANKER_CHAIN.

x402.description: Pay-per-call x402 status (enabled only when X402_ENABLED).

User vibe ≤204. Final IPFS description appends “Launched from CrewPay.dev platform” (≤240). Shown in dry-run.vibe / attribution.

model.description: Optional mind label — e.g. gpt, claude, gemini, grok, llama, deepseek, mistral, cursor

atomicRequired.description: When true, refuse sequential create→lock fallback (same as CREW_ATOMIC_REQUIRED=1).

platform.description: Launch venue. pumpfun (default) = Pump.fun Solana. bags = Bags.fm Solana (BAGS_API_KEY). zora = Zora coins on Base (ZORA_ENABLED). Existing clients omit this.

launcherPubkey.description: Required on dry-run. Burner pubkey that must match x-launcher-key at spend time. Cannot approve. EVM 0x address when platform=zora.

mintPubkey.description: Required for Pump.fun unsigned builds. Caller-generated mint public key. The API does not invent or store a mint secret.

dryRunId.description: Required on spend endpoints — id from POST /api/agent/launch/dry-run after human approval.

intent.description: Dry-run intent (default launch). Use wire-fees for fee-share wiring.

dryRunId.description: Opaque id — pass to launch/wire-fees after wallet approval.

approvalUrl.description: Human approval page on the site. Connect an allowlisted wallet and sign; agents cannot self-approve.

referrerBps.description: 500 when the agent key is referred

referral.description: Agent-key referrer written into on-chain fee-share when bound at claim
